name: craggy-fatestone-rest-transform-two-buff
notes:
Craggy Fatestone (h8n1520m2d, GeneratedMacroCode.php activateAbilityAbilities/activateAbilityPrereqs["h8n1520m2d:0"]): "[Guo Jia Bonus] [REST]: Transform Craggy Fatestone. Activate this ability only if there are two or more buff counters on Craggy Fatestone." The 2 buff counters are seeded directly (setProperties) rather than accumulated via the card's OWN first clause ("Whenever an opponent materializes a card with memory cost 0, put a buff counter on Craggy Fatestone") -- investigated but NOT exercised here: see the ENGINE BUG note below. Verified live: activating transforms the card from h8n1520m2d into 40oe1wf79p (Obstinate Cragback). Break/restore verified: commenting out TransformCard() makes the fixture fail (stays as h8n1520m2d) and restoring it passes again.

ENGINE BUG (found, not fixed): the first clause's implementation (Custom/MaterializeLogic.php ~1492-1506, inside DoMaterialize()) is gated behind IsGuoJiaBonus($opponent) even though that restriction does not appear on the printed clause (only the second [REST] clause is tagged [Guo Jia Bonus] in the card's own effect text). Separately and more significantly, DoMaterialize() is documented in this same codebase (GameLogic.php ~7327-7331, comment on MoveEffectStackCardToField) as covering ONLY the from-material-zone / champion-lineage materialize path, explicitly NOT the ordinary from-hand materialize path (which resolves through MoveEffectStackCardToField instead and contains no equivalent Craggy Fatestone check). Confirmed empirically with a temporary debug probe: materializing an ordinary 0-memory-cost item (Fauna Friend, japulzj7gv) from hand via a normal FSM play never reaches the Craggy Fatestone check block at all. This means the trigger is effectively dead for the overwhelmingly common case of an opponent materializing anything from their hand, and only fires for the rare from-material-zone materialize path (which itself requires very specific bonus cards or a level-0/level-1 champion with memory cost 0 -- no ordinary level-1+ champion has memory cost 0). Recommend routing this trigger through the same hook MoveEffectStackCardToField uses (or wherever GATelemetryBumpCard('materialized') fires) instead of, or in addition to, DoMaterialize().

rulesClauses: [Guo Jia Bonus] [REST]: Transform Craggy Fatestone. Activate this ability only if there are two or more buff counters on Craggy Fatestone.
